artifacts.summary: Root-cause analysis and fix recommendations for /task create topic order/registration/zero-topics picker plus task-type keyword false positives (4a, 4d, literature manifest).

memory_candidates.content: manage-topics.sh set TASK_NUM TOPIC already sets the task's topic field AND appends to active_topics in one idempotent state-write.sh call (see manage-topics.sh 'set' subcommand). When a caller needs both effects, don't teach a separate jq filter to touch active_topics inline -- just call manage-topics.sh set after the state write exists. Inline active_topics jq duplicates logic the script already owns and is exactly what topic-assignment-pattern.md was written to eliminate.

AskUserQuestion's real schema is {question, header (1-3 words Title Case), multiSelect: boolean, options: [{label, description}]}. There is no 'type' field and no separate freeText question variant -- free-text input is obtained by making one option (e.g. 'New topic...') trigger a natural-language follow-up in the NEXT turn, not a second machine schema. A doc template using {"type": "select"} or {"type": "freeText"} is stale/wrong regardless of how long it's been copied around.

extension keyword_overrides manifest field: the top-level key under keyword_overrides MUST equal that extension's own task_type (cslib, email, latex, rust, typst all follow this). A manifest whose key doesn't match its task_type (or that has routing_exempt:true and thus no task_type/routing block of its own at all, like literature) is a routing bug -- when found, prefer REMOVING the override rather than remapping the key, if the extension has no real task_type to route to.
